rules.when: The task is a trivial mechanical edit such as a rote rename, formatting sweep, targeted typo fix, or simple file gathering.
rules.why: Free Meta API quota for narrow, low-ambiguity work.

rules.when: The task is a scout or crewmate research task, investigation, or exploration.
rules.why: Muse rides Meta API directly (free, separate quota) and is optimized for crewmate/scout work; agy and codex fall through when Meta quota is tight.

rules.when: The task is a big or ambiguous multi-file feature, a risky refactor, or work that requires holding many moving parts in mind.
rules.why: Strong coding profiles on independent quota pools (OpenAI cli-rpc, native Anthropic OAuth, Meta API); resolve through quota-array-dispatch.
